last.verdict: Teva raised 2026 guidance again as Austedo, Ajovy and Uzedy grew fast, but total revenue still fell 2% on weaker generics.

takeaways.label: Guidance raised again
takeaways.text: 2026 revenue outlook rose to $16.7–17.0 billion from $16.5–16.85 billion. Austedo, Ajovy and Uzedy forecasts were all lifted. Profit guidance was left almost unchanged at $1.92–2.11 per share.

takeaways.label: Brand drugs drive growth
takeaways.text: Austedo sales were $751 million, up 21%. Ajovy reached $269 million, up 61%, and Uzedy $85 million, up 96%. Austedo's full-year target now sits at $2.55–2.65 billion.

takeaways.label: Margins widened
takeaways.text: Adjusted gross margin rose to 58.7% from 55.3%, and adjusted operating margin to 31.7% from 28.9%. Adjusted EPS was $0.86 versus $0.78 a year ago.

takeaways.label: Generics drag, deals weigh
takeaways.text: Revenue of $4.4 billion fell 2%, mainly on lower U.S. sales of generic lenalidomide. Reported EPS dropped to $0.20 from $0.37. New schizophrenia injection Weltruza is cleared for launch, and BXCL-501 is under FDA review.

history.verdict: Stronger brand-drug sales and raised guidance outweighed a profit miss.

reasons.label: Austedo outlook raised
reasons.text: 2026 Austedo sales guidance lifted to $2.45–2.6 billion; U.S. sales up 33%.

reasons.label: Revenue guidance raised
reasons.text: 2026 revenue outlook raised to $16.5–16.85 billion on Austedo, Ajovy and Uzedy.

reasons.label: Miss blamed on deal
reasons.text: Adjusted EPS of 2 cents missed; Emalex acquisition cost about 61 cents per share.
